paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: http_probe tool — check status, latency and headers of any HTTP endpoint.
# dsh-http-probe
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds an `http_probe` tool: the agent can check the status code, laten
cy and key response headers of any HTTP(S) endpoint without reading response bodies. Useful for API
health checks and quick "is this site up?" questions.
一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供 `http_probe` 工具：让 agent 可以探测任意 HTTP(S) 端点的状态码、延迟和关键响应头（不读取响应体）。适合 API 健康检查
rness 插件，提供 `http_probe` 工具：让 agent 可以探测任意 HTTP(S) 端点的状态码、延迟和关键响应头（不读取响应体）。适合 API 健康检查和"这个服务挂了吗"类问题。
HEAD is the default; a 405 (method not allowed) or 501 (method not implemented) response is retried
once as GET. This supports servers that implement GET but omit HEAD. An explicit GET returning eithe
r status is reported without a retry. The probe cancels its unread GET body after receiving headers,
including streaming bodies. This releases an unshared response promptly. If middleware has cloned t
he body, only the probe's branch is cancelled; upstream downloading can continue while another reade
r keeps its branch open. Latency measures the time to receive the headers. If an unread body has alr
eady failed, the received status and headers are still reported. Cancellation is started without awa
iting it: when middleware clones a streaming response, completing cancellation can depend on the oth
er reader, which must not block the probe result.
默认使用 HEAD，遇到 405（不允许该方法）或 501（未实现该方法）时回退一次 GET，兼容只实现 GET 的服务。显式 GET 若返回这些状态码，则直接报告，不再重试。获取响应头后会取消探测所
持有的 GET 响应体，包括持续流式响应；未共享的响应会及时释放。若中间件克隆了响应体，只取消探测自身的分支；另一位读取者保持其分支开启时，上游仍可能继续下载。延迟统计为获取响应头耗时。未读取的响应体
若已失败，仍保留已经收到的状态码和响应头。取消操作会立即发起，但不等待其完成：中间件若克隆了流式响应，取消完成可能依赖另一位读取者，不应因此阻塞探测结果。
Cancelling the Harness tool call also aborts its pending HTTP request and prevents a HEAD-to-GET ret
ry. Each request still has its own 10-second timeout.
Method names follow Fetch: `DELETE`, `GET`, `HEAD`, `OPTIONS`, `POST` and `PUT` are normalized to up
percase. Other methods retain their exact casing, so `PATCH` and `patch` can probe different server
Other methods retain their exact casing, so `PATCH` and `patch` can probe different server behavior.
取消 Harness 工具调用时，会同时中止尚未完成的 HTTP 请求，并阻止后续 GET 回退。每次请求仍保留独立的 10 秒超时。
方法名遵循 Fetch 规则：`DELETE`、`GET`、`HEAD`、`OPTIONS`、`POST` 和 `PUT` 会规范为大写，其它方法保留原始大小写，因此 `PATCH` 与 `patch
LETE`、`GET`、`HEAD`、`OPTIONS`、`POST` 和 `PUT` 会规范为大写，其它方法保留原始大小写，因此 `PATCH` 与 `patch` 可用于探测服务端不同的处理行为。
